x: Good evening and welcome to Stadium Bravo! Quick match bomb, first to three, and we are following Huus tonight.
Thanks Ryan. Huus's squad starts on defence. Coss, Leocemia, Trottaz and KiKi KaKo alongside him. Let's see what they lock in.
And Huus goes Tachanka! The Lord himself is in the building.
Bold pick. On the other side we've got Alex Snoob, M L S Guy, Zeus, Dren and Skillzi. A Thermite, a Zero, a Zofia. That's a hard breach kit.
Round one. Defenders on second floor, Armory Lockers and Archives.
Thorn, Mute, Smoke, Valkyrie and the turret. Honestly that's a very sticky site if they hold their angles.
Prep phase ticking down. Reinforcements going up, Huus getting the gun into position.
With Zero on the other side, expect cameras through the walls. The early information war matters here.
And we are live! Action phase, round one.
Attackers will want to clear the outside first. Watch for Striker and Ace looking for an early pick.
Contact! Leocemia, the Thorn, headshot on Skillzi! First blood to the defence!
Clean. Five versus four, and the Striker is gone early.
But Alex Snoob answers straight back, the Thermite takes down KiKi KaKo.
That's the Smoke gone, and that hurts the late round. Smoke is your denial when they go for the plant.
Huus on the angle... oh, and he's dropped! M L S Guy, the Zero, one tap on the Tachanka!

Trottaz answers! The Mute picks off Zeus, the Zofia is down!
Three versus three. The trade game is perfectly even right now.
Huus spectating now, watching through his team's eyes. Three on three, and every angle matters.
Dren, the Ace, finds Leocemia! The Thorn goes down!
Two defenders left, against three. They need to play time, not chase.
Headshot! Alex Snoob gets Coss! The Valkyrie is out!
Trottaz, one versus three, the last defender standing!
Fifty seconds on the clock. It's a big ask.
And M L S Guy closes it out. Round one to the attackers.
Here's the kill cam on Huus. The Zero had the line on that turret position, and it only takes one bullet.
Zero one, then. Round two, still defending.
They switch to the first floor, Service and Kitchen. Huus swaps the Tachanka for Skopos this time.
Skopos, two bodies, one brain. Let's see if the robots buy them some information.
Castle on the doors, Thorn, Valkyrie cams. Attackers with Twitch drones, Zofia and Nomad. They'll want to burn the gadgets first.
Twenty seconds of prep left. Everyone settling into position.
After losing round one, the key thing is not to give up free kills early. Patience.
Round two is go!
Quiet start. Both teams playing for information.
Huus moving the Skopos shell, looking for a peek.
Info is everything here. If the defenders know where the Twitch is, they can collapse.
Skillzi, the Twitch, headshot on Trottaz! The Castle is down!
But Coss trades! The Valkyrie gets Zeus!
Four versus four.
Huus! Huus with the Skopos takes out M L S Guy! Revenge for round one!
He got the Zero this time. Defenders up, four versus three!
Dren, the Nomad, removes Leocemia!
And Skillzi again! He's through Huus, and Coss! It's over!
Wow. Skillzi takes the round almost single handed. Three kills for the Twitch. Zero two.
Skillzi was the difference there. Three kills on the Twitch, and the round.
Match point for the enemy. Huus's team switches to attack, and they have to win this one.

Ash, Nomad, Ace, Jackal. That's an aggressive attacking lineup.

Objective is first floor, Showers and Server.

Drone phase, the attackers scouting. Vigil is invisible to cameras, so watch the corners.
Round three. Everything on the line!
The IQ's detector shows every gadget behind a wall. That's the information Huus is playing for.
Attackers taking their time, working the exterior.
First blood to Skillzi again! The Thorn picks off Coss, the Nomad!
That player has been the story of the match. Four versus five, early.
Dren with the Vigil finds Trottaz! The Ash is down! Three versus five!
This is getting away from them. Somebody has to make a play.
Huus pushing in with the IQ...
And there it is! Huus deletes Skillzi! Finally someone stops him!
But the Vigil gets Conter Gordox straight away!
Two versus four now. Huus and Leocemia left.
Leocemia! Headshot on Dren! The Vigil is gone! Two versus three!
Now we have a game. Twenty seconds ago this looked over.
Oh no, Zeus finds Leocemia. The Solis gets the Ace.
So it's down to Huus. One versus three, fifty seconds on the clock, and he needs the plant.
Huus slowly working the angles. The IQ detector up, reading the room.
He has to pick his fights, one at a time. Do not let them trade.
Zeus is down! Huus takes the Solis! One versus two!
And M L S Guy! Huus takes the Mute! One versus one!
He grabs the defuser! Ten seconds! He has to run!
Can he make it? Can he plant? Down the hallway...
Oh! Alex Snoob is waiting! It's over!
So close. That would have been a clutch for the highlight reel.
Three nil to the enemy, but what a finish from Huus. Three kills in round three, and almost the impossible one versus three.
The story of the match is Skillzi, but Huus had the moment of the night. Back at it next time.
That's all from Stadium Bravo. Goodnight!
